{
  "analysis": "The inspected arena Cast delegates resource charging to Combat.BeginCast, which contains one mana deduction after rejection checks. No duplicate deduction is visible in this path. This scenario measures actual successful casts and cooldown rejections without advancing time between paired observations, then checks a later rejection with ordinary mana regeneration accounted for. No failure has yet been observed.",
  "needsReview": false,
  "requests": [],
  "scenario": {
    "title": "Actual arena casts charge once and cooldown rejections preserve resources",
    "expectedBehavior": "Morgana E spends its listed 70 mana and starts a 14-second cooldown while granting a shield. Cooldown recasts preserve mana, the ready timestamp, and shield expiry. An independent Ahri Q spends 55 mana and creates one projectile.",
    "player": "Morgana",
    "opponent": "Ahri",
    "seed": 413,
    "actions": [
      {"op":"cast","unit":"player","target":"","field":"","text":"","label":"shield_cast","champion":"","slot":"E","x":-6,"y":-2,"value":0,"seconds":0,"dt":0,"red":false},
      {"op":"cast","unit":"player","target":"","field":"","text":"","label":"immediate_recast","champion":"","slot":"E","x":-6,"y":-2,"value":0,"seconds":0,"dt":0,"red":false},
      {"op":"cast","unit":"enemy","target":"","field":"","text":"","label":"normal_projectile","champion":"","slot":"Q","x":6,"y":6,"value":0,"seconds":0,"dt":0,"red":false},
      {"op":"advance","unit":"","target":"","field":"","text":"","label":"regenerated","champion":"","slot":"","x":0,"y":0,"value":0,"seconds":0.5,"dt":0.016666667,"red":false},
      {"op":"cast","unit":"player","target":"","field":"","text":"","label":"delayed_recast","champion":"","slot":"E","x":-6,"y":-2,"value":0,"seconds":0,"dt":0,"red":false}
    ],
    "checks": [
      {"label":"E charges listed cost once","at":"shield_cast","unit":"player","field":"mana","relation":"eq","compareAt":"initial","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"mana","value":-70,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"E starts listed cooldown","at":"shield_cast","unit":"player","field":"cooldownE","relation":"eq","compareAt":"","compareUnit":"","compareField":"","value":14,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"E actually grants shield","at":"shield_cast","unit":"player","field":"shielded","relation":"eq","compareAt":"","compareUnit":"","compareField":"","value":1,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Immediate rejection preserves mana","at":"immediate_recast","unit":"player","field":"mana","relation":"eq","compareAt":"shield_cast","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"mana","value":0,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Immediate rejection preserves ready time","at":"immediate_recast","unit":"player","field":"readyE","relation":"eq","compareAt":"shield_cast","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"readyE","value":0,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Q charges listed cost once","at":"normal_projectile","unit":"enemy","field":"mana","relation":"eq","compareAt":"initial","compareUnit":"enemy","compareField":"mana","value":-55,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Q creates projectile","at":"normal_projectile","unit":"world","field":"shots","relation":"eq","compareAt":"immediate_recast","compareUnit":"world","compareField":"shots","value":1,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Ordinary regeneration control","at":"regenerated","unit":"player","field":"mana","relation":"eq","compareAt":"immediate_recast","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"mana","value":3,"tolerance":0.01},
      {"label":"Delayed rejection preserves mana","at":"delayed_recast","unit":"player","field":"mana","relation":"eq","compareAt":"regenerated","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"mana","value":0,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Delayed rejection does not extend cooldown","at":"delayed_recast","unit":"player","field":"readyE","relation":"eq","compareAt":"shield_cast","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"readyE","value":0,"tolerance":0.001},
      {"label":"Delayed rejection does not refresh shield","at":"delayed_recast","unit":"player","field":"shieldUntil","relation":"eq","compareAt":"shield_cast","compareUnit":"player","compareField":"shieldUntil","value":0,"tolerance":0.001}
    ]
  }
}
